title: Headscale
author: Marcus Quinn <marcus@marcusquinn.com>
description: Self-hosted Tailscale-compatible mesh VPN control server with an embedded DERP relay.

STUN_PORT.title: STUN (NAT traversal)
STUN_PORT.description: UDP port for embedded DERP STUN NAT traversal.

postInstallMessage: Headscale is running. Create a user with cloudron exec, then enrol clients with tailscale up --login-server https://${CLOUDRON_APP_DOMAIN}. UDP ${STUN_PORT} improves NAT traversal.
